en.baptism: In the year one thousand eight hundred and eighty-seven, on the twentieth day of May, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, Fr. Jacewicz baptised an infant named Jan with all the rites of the Sacrament.

issues.en: Illegitimate birth ('незаконно рождемныи сынъ'): only the mother is named. The village lies in the Kontoskii [?] parish, not 'this parish'. Priest's title omitted in the draft. Day '20' is read from 'двадца таго'.
issues.lt: Nesantuokinis vaikas; gimimo parapija (Kontosko [?]) skiriasi nuo šios parapijos; krikštijęs kunigas be titulo „vikaras“; krikštatėvių duomenys neaiškūs.

issues.en: 'ворянъ' repaired to 'Дворянъ' (nobles); 'Тѣзда' read as 'Уѣзда' (district). Father's name 'Шзаца' read as Ignacy. Mother's name and surnames uncertain; parish word garbled.
